meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你排查容器化 agent 的问题：读主机日志、查会话数据库（inbound.db / outbound.db）、核对挂载点与心跳文件，定位消息没送达或容器启动失败的原因。
howto.when: 当出现消息发不出去、容器启动即退出、认证报错，或你想弄清容器系统如何运作时触发。

say.text: 机器人不回复了，帮我查日志和会话数据库
say.note: 会比对两个会话库与主机日志定位断点

say.text: 容器一启动就退出，看看是什么原因
say.note: 会读容器 stderr 和退出码

say.text: 检查一下挂载点和 .heartbeat 是否正常
say.note: 会列出容器挂载目标和心跳时间

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude helps debug the containerized agent: it reads host logs, inspects the two session DBs, checks mounts and heartbeats, and traces why messages weren't delivered or a container failed to start.
howto.when_en: Triggers when things aren't working: a container fails, authentication errors appear, messages go unanswered, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The bot stopped replying — check the logs and session DBs
say_en.note: Traces both session DBs and host logs

say_en.text: The container exits right after it starts, find out why
say_en.note: Reads container stderr and exit code

say_en.text: Check whether mounts and .heartbeat are healthy
say_en.note: Lists mount targets and heartbeat mtime
